The atelier

Local roots. Global standards.

We are a Marrakech atelier for travelers who would rather not be handled. Every journey is designed, held and run by people who live here — so the country opens the right doors, at the right hour.

Private by default

No groups. No flags. A driver who knows your name, a guide who knows when to disappear, and a pace that belongs only to you.

Doors that stay closed

After-hours palaces, artisan ateliers, and tables that are not listed. Access is the quiet luxury most itineraries cannot buy.

Stays with a sense of place

Hand-picked Marrakech properties, Skoura properties, and the Sahara camps we actually sleep-test. Character first. Service always.

A Marrakech atelier, not a call center

Your journey is designed and run by people who live here. When something shifts, we are already in the medina — not in another time zone.

American hours, Moroccan ground

Planning calls on Eastern and Pacific time. Clear USD pricing. Direct-flight logic from JFK, EWR, IAD, BOS, MIA, and the West Coast.

Concierge that never clocks out

A single WhatsApp thread from first sketch to last transfer. Last-minute table, earlier balloon, a doctor at 2 a.m. — handled.

How a journey begins

Four movements. Then you arrive.

  1. 01

    A conversation, not a form.

    We start with how you travel — not a checkbox of cities. Pace, privacy, who is in the car, what you refuse to miss.

    A private itinerary.

    Within days, a designed journey: stays held, routes timed for light, reservations that are actually honored.

    Refinement until it feels inevitable.

    You push back. We adjust. The draft becomes a document you stop editing because it already sounds like you.

  4. 04

    You simply arrive.

    Meet-and-greet, the right SIM, the right car. From that moment the country is handled. You are free to be in it.

Your Morocco, your way.Private Morocco, curated for the well travelled.

About us

Morocco Is Our Home. Making It Meaningful Is Our Craft.

WE ARE MOROCCO is a Morocco-based Destination Management Company creating private, tailor-made journeys for discerning travelers through close collaboration with travel advisors.

Morocco is a country of remarkable contrasts — imperial cities and hidden riads, ancient medinas and contemporary design, vast desert landscapes and mountain villages, centuries-old traditions and an evolving cultural scene.

But experiencing Morocco well takes more than knowing where to go. It takes an understanding of its people, its rhythms, its cultural nuances, and the details that transform a visit into something genuinely memorable.

That is where we come in.

Rooted in Morocco and shaped by an intimate understanding of the destination, we bring together carefully selected accommodations, private transportation, knowledgeable local experts, meaningful cultural encounters, and thoughtful on-the-ground coordination to create journeys that feel personal from beginning to end.

We do not believe in one way to experience Morocco. We believe in discovering the right Morocco for each traveler.

Why travelers choose us

Our approach

More Than an Itinerary.

We see ourselves as the people behind the experience — connecting the right places, people, and moments to create a journey that feels effortless without losing its sense of discovery.

Our approach combines local knowledge with careful planning and personal attention. Every detail has a purpose, every recommendation is considered, and every journey is designed around the people taking it.

Whether the priority is cultural discovery, exceptional hospitality, time in the mountains, a private Sahara experience, or simply the freedom to explore at a comfortable pace, we shape the journey around what matters most to the traveler.

Our signature journeys offer inspiration and a starting point. Our tailor-made approach allows us to go further, adapting the route, rhythm, accommodations, and experiences to each client's individual interests and expectations.

For travel advisors

A Trusted Partner for Travel Advisors

We work alongside travel advisors who want to offer their clients a deeper, more personal experience of Morocco.

You bring your understanding of the traveler. We bring our destination expertise, local relationships, and operational knowledge.

Together, we develop journeys that reflect the client's expectations while providing the reassurance of a dedicated team on the ground.

From the initial itinerary design to the coordination of the journey itself, we believe in clear communication, thoughtful recommendations, and a collaborative approach. Our role is to support your relationship with your client — never replace it.

The Guardian Guide

A Familiar Face Throughout the Journey

At the heart of our journeys is the Guardian Guide: a dedicated English-speaking host who accompanies guests throughout their private journey.

More than a traditional guide, the Guardian Guide is a cultural interpreter, trusted local contact, and personal advisor — someone who helps travelers understand Morocco beyond the familiar landmarks.

This continuity brings a human dimension to the journey. It allows recommendations to reflect the guests' evolving interests and gives them the confidence to explore with someone who understands both the destination and their preferences.

Our philosophy

Your Morocco, Your Way.

We believe luxury is not simply about adding more. It is about choosing what is right for each traveler.

The right pace. The right places. The right experiences. The freedom to change direction when curiosity leads somewhere unexpected.

We remain attentive to the details while leaving room for spontaneity, discovery, and genuine human connection.

Because the most memorable journeys are not necessarily the ones that do the most. They are the ones that make you feel the most.
